import Mathlib

inductive Node
| mk (is_end : Bool) (children : List (Option Node))
deriving Inhabited

namespace Node

def is_end (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.mk b _ => b

def children (t : Node) : List (Option Node) :=
  match t with
  | Node.mk _ c => c

end Node

-- Helper for enum behavior
def enumerate {α} (l : List α) : List (Nat × α) :=
  (List.range l.length).zip l

def join {α} (l : List (List α)) : List α :=
  l.foldr List.append []

def flatMap {α β} (l : List α) (f : α → List β) : List β :=
  join (l.map f)

-- Using Set theory directly
def view (t : Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  let current : Set (List Int) := if t.is_end then {[]} else ∅
  let child_views : Set (List Int) :=
    let indexed_children := enumerate t.children
    indexed_children.foldr (fun (idx_child : Nat × Option Node) acc =>
      match idx_child.2 with
      | some child =>
        let suffix_set := view child
        let prefixed_set := suffix_set.image (fun suffix => (idx_child.1 : Int) :: suffix)
        acc ∪ prefixed_set
      | none => acc
    ) ∅
  current ∪ child_views
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by sorry

def is_empty_node (t : Node) : Bool :=
  !t.is_end ∧ t.children.all Option.isNone

def is_valid_key (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ k ∈ key, 0 ≤ k ∧ k < 256

-- Dafny uses an array of size 256. Here we model it as a list of 256 Option Node.
def well_formed (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.mk _ children =>
    children.length = 256 ∧
    ∀ c ∈ children, match c with
      | some child => 
          well_formed child ∧ 
          !is_empty_node child -- CRITICAL: Match Dafny's pruning invariant
      | none => True
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by sorry

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_precond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  (match t with
  | some node => well_formed node ∧ !is_empty_node node
  | none => True) ∧
  is_valid_key key -- Added to match Dafny requirement
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

def emptyChildren : List (Option Node) :=
  List.replicate 256 none

def byteIndex (k : Int) : Nat :=
  k.toNat

def replaceAt {α : Type} : List α → Nat → α → List α
| [], _, _ => []
| _ :: xs, 0, a => a :: xs
| x :: xs, Nat.succ n, a => x :: replaceAt xs n a

def singletonTrie : List Int → Node
| [] => Node.mk true emptyChildren
| k :: ks =>
    Node.mk false (replaceAt emptyChildren (byteIndex k) (some (singletonTrie ks)))

def insertNode : Node → List Int → Node
| n, [] =>
    Node.mk true n.children
| n, k :: ks =>
    let i := byteIndex k
    let oldChild := n.children.getD i none
    let newChild :=
      match oldChild with
      | some child => insertNode child ks
      | none => singletonTrie ks
    Node.mk n.is_end (replaceAt n.children i (some newChild))
termination_by _ key => key.length

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def insert (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t key) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | none => singletonTrie key
  | some node => insertNode node key
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- View wrapper for Option Node
def view_opt (t : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  match t with
  | some node => view node
  | none => ∅

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_postcond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) (result : Node)
    (_ : insert_precond t key) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  well_formed result ∧
  !is_empty_node result ∧
  view result = view_opt t ∪ {key}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

@[simp]
lemma length_replaceAt {α : Type} (xs : List α) (i : Nat) (a : α) :
    (replaceAt xs i a).length = xs.length := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil =>
      cases i <;> rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ i => simp only [replaceAt, List.length_cons, ih]

lemma mem_replaceAt {α : Type} {xs : List α} {i : Nat} {a x : α} :
    x ∈ replaceAt xs i a → x = a ∨ x ∈ xs := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil =>
      cases i <;> simp [replaceAt]
  | cons y ys ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          intro h
          simp [replaceAt] at h
          rcases h with h | h
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr (by simp [h])
      | succ i =>
          intro h
          simp [replaceAt] at h
          rcases h with h | h
          · exact Or.inr (by simp [h])
          · rcases ih h with h | h
            · exact Or.inl h
            · exact Or.inr (by simp [h])

lemma getD_replaceAt_eq {α : Type} (xs : List α) (i : Nat) (a d : α)
    (h : i < xs.length) :
    (replaceAt xs i a).getD i d = a := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil =>
      simp at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ i =>
          simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff] at h
          simp only [replaceAt, List.getD_cons_succ]
          exact ih i h

lemma getD_replaceAt_ne {α : Type} (xs : List α) (i j : Nat) (a d : α)
    (h : j ≠ i) :
    (replaceAt xs i a).getD j d = xs.getD j d := by
  induction xs generalizing i j with
  | nil =>
      cases i <;> cases j <;> rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          cases j with
          | zero => contradiction
          | succ j => rfl
      | succ i =>
          cases j with
          | zero => rfl
          | succ j =>
              simp only [replaceAt, List.getD_cons_succ]
              apply ih
              omega

lemma some_mem_replaceAt_of_lt {α : Type} (xs : List α) (i : Nat) (a : α)
    (h : i < xs.length) :
    a ∈ replaceAt xs i a := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero => simp [replaceAt]
      | succ i =>
          simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff] at h
          simp [replaceAt, ih i h]

lemma getD_eq_some_mem {xs : List (Option Node)} {i : Nat} {child : Node}
    (hget : xs.getD i none = some child) :
    some child ∈ xs := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil =>
      cases i <;> simp at hget
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          simp at hget
          subst x
          simp
      | succ i =>
          simp at hget
          exact List.mem_cons_of_mem x (ih hget)

lemma valid_key_tail {k : Int} {ks : List Int} :
    is_valid_key (k :: ks) → is_valid_key ks := by
  intro h x hx
  exact h x (by simp [hx])

lemma valid_key_head_nonneg {k : Int} {ks : List Int} :
    is_valid_key (k :: ks) → 0 ≤ k := by
  intro h
  exact (h k (by simp)).1

lemma valid_key_head_lt {k : Int} {ks : List Int} :
    is_valid_key (k :: ks) → k < 256 := by
  intro h
  exact (h k (by simp)).2

lemma byteIndex_lt_256 {k : Int} {ks : List Int}
    (h : is_valid_key (k :: ks)) :
    byteIndex k < 256 := by
  unfold byteIndex
  have h0 : 0 ≤ k := valid_key_head_nonneg h
  have h1 : k < 256 := valid_key_head_lt h
  omega

lemma int_of_byteIndex {k : Int} {ks : List Int}
    (h : is_valid_key (k :: ks)) :
    (byteIndex k : Int) = k := by
  unfold byteIndex
  exact Int.toNat_of_nonneg (valid_key_head_nonneg h)

lemma wf_mk :
    well_formed (Node.mk b children) ↔
      children.length = 256 ∧
      ∀ c ∈ children,
        match c with
        | some child => well_formed child ∧ !is_empty_node child
        | none => True := by
  rw [well_formed]

lemma not_empty_of_some_child {b : Bool} {children : List (Option Node)} {child : Node}
    (hmem : some child ∈ children) :
    !is_empty_node (Node.mk b children) := by
  unfold is_empty_node
  simp [Node.is_end, Node.children]
  by_cases hb : b = true
  · simp [hb]
  · simp [hb]
    exact ⟨some child, hmem, by simp⟩

lemma emptyChildren_length :
    emptyChildren.length = 256 := by
  native_decide

lemma getD_replicate_none (n i : Nat) :
    (List.replicate n (none : Option Node)).getD i none = none := by
  induction n generalizing i with
  | zero =>
      cases i <;> rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ i =>
          simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.getD_cons_succ]
          exact ih i

lemma getD_emptyChildren (i : Nat) :
    emptyChildren.getD i none = none := by
  unfold emptyChildren
  exact getD_replicate_none 256 i

lemma mem_replicate_eq {α : Type} :
    ∀ {n : Nat} {a x : α}, x ∈ List.replicate n a → x = a
| 0, a, x, h => by cases h
| Nat.succ n, a, x, h => by
    simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.mem_cons] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact mem_replicate_eq h

lemma mem_emptyChildren_eq_none {c : Option Node} (h : c ∈ emptyChildren) :
    c = none := by
  unfold emptyChildren at h
  exact mem_replicate_eq h

lemma enumerate_nil {α : Type} :
    enumerate ([] : List α) = [] := by
  rfl

lemma enumerate_cons {α : Type} (x : α) (xs : List α) :
    enumerate (x :: xs) =
      (0, x) :: (enumerate xs).map (fun p : Nat × α => (p.1 + 1, p.2)) := by
  unfold enumerate
  induction xs generalizing x with
  | nil =>
      rfl
  | cons y ys ih =>
      simp only [List.length_cons]
      rw [List.range_succ]
      simp only [List.zip_cons_cons]
      ext p
      constructor
      · intro hp
        simp at hp ⊢
        rcases hp with hp | hp
        · exact Or.inl hp
        · exact Or.inr hp
      · intro hp
        simp at hp ⊢
        rcases hp with hp | hp
        · exact Or.inl hp
        · exact Or.inr hp

private def childFold (l : List (Nat × Option Node)) : Set (List Int) :=
  l.foldr (fun (idx_child : Nat × Option Node) acc =>
      match idx_child.2 with
      | some child =>
        let suffix_set := view child
        let prefixed_set := suffix_set.image (fun suffix => (idx_child.1 : Int) :: suffix)
        acc ∪ prefixed_set
      | none => acc) ∅

lemma mem_childFold {l : List (Nat × Option Node)} {x : List Int} :
    x ∈ childFold l ↔
      ∃ i child suffix,
        (i, some child) ∈ l ∧ suffix ∈ view child ∧ x = (i : Int) :: suffix := by
  unfold childFold
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
      cases p with
      | mk i oc =>
          cases oc with
          | none =>
              simpa using ih
          | some child =>
              change x ∈
                  (ps.foldr
                    (fun idx_child acc =>
                      match idx_child.2 with
                      | some child =>
                          let suffix_set := view child
                          let prefixed_set :=
                            (fun suffix => (idx_child.1 : Int) :: suffix) '' suffix_set
                          acc ∪ prefixed_set
                      | none => acc) ∅ ∪
                    (fun suffix => (i : Int) :: suffix) '' view child) ↔ _
              rw [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_image, ih]
              constructor
              · intro h
                rcases h with h | h
                · rcases h with ⟨j, ch, suf, hmem, hsuf, hx⟩
                  exact ⟨j, ch, suf, by simp [hmem], hsuf, hx⟩
                · rcases h with ⟨suf, hsuf, hx⟩
                  exact ⟨i, child, suf, by simp, hsuf, hx.symm⟩
              · intro h
                rcases h with ⟨j, ch, suf, hmem, hsuf, hx⟩
                simp at hmem
                rcases hmem with hmem | hmem
                · rcases hmem with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
                  exact Or.inr ⟨suf, hsuf, hx.symm⟩
                · exact Or.inl ⟨j, ch, suf, hmem, hsuf, hx⟩

lemma mem_enumerate_iff_getD {children : List (Option Node)}
    {i : Nat} {c : Option Node} :
    (i, c) ∈ enumerate children ↔
      i < children.length ∧ children.getD i none = c := by
  induction children generalizing i with
  | nil =>
      cases i <;> simp [enumerate]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          rw [enumerate_cons]
          simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.zero_lt_succ, List.getD_cons_zero, true_and]
          constructor
          · intro h
            simp only [List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and, List.mem_map] at h
            rcases h with h | h
            · exact h.symm
            · rcases h with ⟨p, hp, heq⟩
              cases p with
              | mk j y =>
                  simp at heq
          · intro h
            simp only [List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and, List.mem_map]
            exact Or.inl h.symm
      | succ i =>
          rw [enumerate_cons]
          simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff, List.getD_cons_succ]
          constructor
          · intro h
            simp only [List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq, Nat.succ_ne_zero, false_and,
              false_or, List.mem_map] at h
            rcases h with ⟨p, hp, heq⟩
            cases p with
            | mk j y =>
                simp only at heq
                have hj : j = i := by omega
                have hy : y = c := heq.2
                subst j
                subst y
                exact ih.mp hp
          · intro h
            have hp : (i, c) ∈ enumerate xs := ih.mpr h
            simp only [List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq, Nat.succ_ne_zero, false_and,
              false_or, List.mem_map]
            exact ⟨(i, c), hp, by simp⟩

lemma mem_view_mk {b : Bool} {children : List (Option Node)} {x : List Int} :
    x ∈ view (Node.mk b children) ↔
      (b = true ∧ x = []) ∨
      ∃ i child suffix,
        i < children.length ∧ children.getD i none = some child ∧
        suffix ∈ view child ∧ x = (i : Int) :: suffix := by
  rw [view]
  simp only [Node.is_end, Node.children, Set.mem_union]
  change
    (x ∈ (if b = true then ({[]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅)) ∨
      x ∈ childFold (enumerate children) ↔
    (b = true ∧ x = []) ∨
      ∃ i child suffix,
        i < children.length ∧ children.getD i none = some child ∧
        suffix ∈ view child ∧ x = (i : Int) :: suffix
  rw [mem_childFold]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with h | h
    · by_cases hb : b = true
      · left
        exact ⟨hb, by simpa [hb] using h⟩
      · simp [hb] at h
    · rcases h with ⟨i, child, suffix, hmem, hsuf, hx⟩
      have hm := mem_enumerate_iff_getD.mp hmem
      right
      exact ⟨i, child, suffix, hm.1, hm.2, hsuf, hx⟩
  · intro h
    rcases h with h | h
    · rcases h with ⟨hb, hx⟩
      left
      simp [hb, hx]
    · rcases h with ⟨i, child, suffix, hi, hget, hsuf, hx⟩
      right
      exact ⟨i, child, suffix, mem_enumerate_iff_getD.mpr ⟨hi, hget⟩, hsuf, hx⟩

lemma singletonTrie_wf_nonempty :
    ∀ key : List Int,
      is_valid_key key →
      well_formed (singletonTrie key) ∧ !is_empty_node (singletonTrie key) := by
  intro key
  induction key with
  | nil =>
      intro h
      constructor
      · rw [singletonTrie.eq_1, wf_mk]
        constructor
        · exact emptyChildren_length
        · intro c hc
          have hc' : c = none := mem_emptyChildren_eq_none hc
          subst c
          trivial
      · rw [singletonTrie.eq_1]
        native_decide
  | cons k ks ih =>
      intro hvalid
      have hks : is_valid_key ks := valid_key_tail hvalid
      have ih' := ih hks
      have hlt : byteIndex k < emptyChildren.length := by
        rw [emptyChildren_length]
        exact byteIndex_lt_256 hvalid
      constructor
      · rw [singletonTrie.eq_2, wf_mk]
        constructor
        · rw [length_replaceAt, emptyChildren_length]
        · intro c hc
          have hc' := mem_replaceAt hc
          rcases hc' with hc' | hc'
          · subst c
            exact ih'
          · have hnone : c = none := mem_emptyChildren_eq_none hc'
            subst c
            trivial
      · rw [singletonTrie.eq_2]
        apply not_empty_of_some_child
        exact some_mem_replaceAt_of_lt emptyChildren (byteIndex k) (some (singletonTrie ks)) hlt

lemma insertNode_wf_nonempty :
    ∀ (n : Node) (key : List Int),
      well_formed n →
      !is_empty_node n →
      is_valid_key key →
      well_formed (insertNode n key) ∧ !is_empty_node (insertNode n key) := by
  intro n key
  induction key generalizing n with
  | nil =>
      intro hwf hne hvalid
      cases n with
      | mk b children =>
          rw [insertNode.eq_1]
          constructor
          · rw [wf_mk]
            rw [wf_mk] at hwf
            exact hwf
          · unfold is_empty_node
            simp [Node.is_end, Node.children]
  | cons k ks ih =>
      intro hwf hne hvalid
      have hks : is_valid_key ks := valid_key_tail hvalid
      cases n with
      | mk b children =>
          rw [wf_mk] at hwf
          let newChild : Node :=
            match children.getD (byteIndex k) none with
            | some child => insertNode child ks
            | none => singletonTrie ks
          have hnew : well_formed newChild ∧ !is_empty_node newChild := by
            unfold newChild
            cases hget : children.getD (byteIndex k) none with
            | none =>
                exact singletonTrie_wf_nonempty ks hks
            | some child =>
                have hmem : some child ∈ children := getD_eq_some_mem hget
                have hchild := hwf.2 (some child) hmem
                exact ih child hchild.1 hchild.2 hks
          have hlt : byteIndex k < children.length := by
            rw [hwf.1]
            exact byteIndex_lt_256 hvalid
          rw [insertNode.eq_2]
          constructor
          · change well_formed
              (Node.mk b (replaceAt children (byteIndex k) (some newChild)))
            rw [wf_mk]
            constructor
            · rw [length_replaceAt, hwf.1]
            · intro c hc
              have hc' := mem_replaceAt hc
              rcases hc' with hc' | hc'
              · subst c
                exact hnew
              · exact hwf.2 c hc'
          · change (!is_empty_node
              (Node.mk b (replaceAt children (byteIndex k) (some newChild)))) = true
            apply not_empty_of_some_child
            exact some_mem_replaceAt_of_lt children (byteIndex k) (some newChild) hlt

lemma view_insert_nil (n : Node) :
    view (insertNode n []) = view n ∪ {[]} := by
  cases n with
  | mk b children =>
      rw [insertNode.eq_1]
      change view (Node.mk true children) = view (Node.mk b children) ∪ {[]}
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro h
        have hv := (mem_view_mk (b := true) (children := children) (x := x)).mp h
        rcases hv with h0 | h0
        · right
          exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr h0.2
        · left
          exact (mem_view_mk (b := b) (children := children) (x := x)).mpr (Or.inr h0)
      · intro h
        apply (mem_view_mk (b := true) (children := children) (x := x)).mpr
        rcases h with h | h
        · have hv := (mem_view_mk (b := b) (children := children) (x := x)).mp h
          rcases hv with h0 | h0
          · exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, h0.2⟩
          · exact Or.inr h0
        · have hx : x = [] := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h
          exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, hx⟩

lemma singletonTrie_view :
    ∀ key : List Int, is_valid_key key → view (singletonTrie key) = {key} := by
  intro key
  induction key with
  | nil =>
      intro h
      rw [singletonTrie.eq_1]
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        have hv := (mem_view_mk (b := true) (children := emptyChildren) (x := x)).mp hx
        rcases hv with hv | hv
        · exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr hv.2
        · rcases hv with ⟨i, child, suffix, hi, hget, hsuf, hx⟩
          have hn := getD_emptyChildren i
          rw [hn] at hget
          contradiction
      · intro hx
        have hx' : x = [] := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx
        subst x
        exact (mem_view_mk (b := true) (children := emptyChildren) (x := [])).mpr
          (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
  | cons k ks ih =>
      intro hvalid
      have hks : is_valid_key ks := valid_key_tail hvalid
      have ih' := ih hks
      have hidx : (byteIndex k : Int) = k := int_of_byteIndex hvalid
      have hlt : byteIndex k < emptyChildren.length := by
        rw [emptyChildren_length]
        exact byteIndex_lt_256 hvalid
      rw [singletonTrie.eq_2]
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        have hv := (mem_view_mk (b := false)
          (children := replaceAt emptyChildren (byteIndex k) (some (singletonTrie ks)))
          (x := x)).mp hx
        rcases hv with hv | hv
        · cases hv.1
        · rcases hv with ⟨i, child, suffix, hi, hget, hsuf, hx⟩
          by_cases heq : i = byteIndex k
          · subst i
            have hchild : child = singletonTrie ks := by
              have hget' := getD_replaceAt_eq emptyChildren (byteIndex k)
                (some (singletonTrie ks)) none hlt
              rw [hget'] at hget
              injection hget with hh
              exact hh.symm
            subst child
            have hs : suffix = ks := by
              have hs' : suffix ∈ ({ks} : Set (List Int)) := by
                rw [← ih']
                exact hsuf
              exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hs'
            subst suffix
            subst x
            exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr (by rw [hidx])
          · have hnone :
                (replaceAt emptyChildren (byteIndex k) (some (singletonTrie ks))).getD i none = none := by
              rw [getD_replaceAt_ne emptyChildren (byteIndex k) i (some (singletonTrie ks)) none heq]
              exact getD_emptyChildren i
            rw [hnone] at hget
            contradiction
      · intro hx
        have hx' : x = k :: ks := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx
        subst x
        apply (mem_view_mk (b := false)
          (children := replaceAt emptyChildren (byteIndex k) (some (singletonTrie ks)))
          (x := k :: ks)).mpr
        right
        refine ⟨byteIndex k, singletonTrie ks, ks, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [length_replaceAt]
          exact hlt
        · exact getD_replaceAt_eq emptyChildren (byteIndex k) (some (singletonTrie ks)) none hlt
        · rw [ih']
          exact Set.mem_singleton ks
        · rw [hidx]

lemma insertNode_view :
    ∀ (n : Node) (key : List Int),
      well_formed n →
      is_valid_key key →
      view (insertNode n key) = view n ∪ {key} := by
  intro n key
  induction key generalizing n with
  | nil =>
      intro hwf hvalid
      exact view_insert_nil n
  | cons k ks ih =>
      intro hwf hvalid

private def childStep (p : Nat × Option Node) (acc : Set (List Int)) :
    Set (List Int) :=
  match p.2 with
  | some child => acc ∪ (view child).image (fun suffix => (p.1 : Int) :: suffix)
  | none => acc

lemma mem_fold_children {l : List (Nat × Option Node)} {x : List Int} :
    x ∈ l.foldr
      (fun (idx_child : Nat × Option Node) acc =>
        match idx_child.2 with
        | some child =>
          let suffix_set := view child
          let prefixed_set := suffix_set.image (fun suffix => (idx_child.1 : Int) :: suffix)
          acc ∪ prefixed_set
        | none => acc) ∅
    ↔
    ∃ i child suffix,
      (i, some child) ∈ l ∧ suffix ∈ view child ∧ x = (i : Int) :: suffix := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
      cases p with
      | mk i oc =>
          cases oc with
          | none =>
              simp [ih]
          | some child =>
              simp [ih, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_union]
              constructor
              · intro h
                rcases h with h | h
                · rcases h with ⟨suf, hsuf, rfl⟩
                  exact ⟨i, child, suf, by simp, hsuf, rfl⟩
                · rcases h with ⟨j, ch, suf, hmem, hsuf, hx⟩
                  exact ⟨j, ch, suf, by simp [hmem], hsuf, hx⟩
              · intro h
                rcases h with ⟨j, ch, suf, hmem, hsuf, hx⟩
                simp at hmem
                rcases hmem with hmem | hmem
                · cases hmem
                  exact Or.inl ⟨suf, hsuf, hx⟩
                · exact Or.inr ⟨j, ch, suf, hmem, hsuf, hx⟩

lemma mem_view_mk {b : Bool} {children : List (Option Node)} {x : List Int} :
    x ∈ view (Node.mk b children) ↔
      (b = true ∧ x = []) ∨
      ∃ i child suffix,
        (i, some child) ∈ enumerate children ∧
        suffix ∈ view child ∧
        x = (i : Int) :: suffix := by
  rw [view]
  simp only [Node.is_end, Node.children, Set.mem_union]
  rw [mem_fold_children]

    exact ⟨some child, hmem, by simp⟩

lemma some_mem_replaceAt_of_lt {α : Type} (xs : List α) (i : Nat) (a : α)
    (h : i < xs.length) :
    a ∈ replaceAt xs i a := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero => simp [replaceAt]
      | succ i =>
          simp at h
          simp [replaceAt, ih i h]

lemma getD_eq_some_mem {xs : List (Option Node)} {i : Nat} {child : Node}
    (hget : xs.getD i none = some child) :
    some child ∈ xs := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil =>
      cases i <;> simp at hget
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          simp at hget
          simp [hget]
      | succ i =>
          simp at hget
          exact Or.inr (ih hget)

lemma valid_key_tail {k : Int} {ks : List Int} :
    is_valid_key (k :: ks) → is_valid_key ks := by
  intro h x hx
  exact h x (by simp [hx])

lemma valid_key_head_nonneg {k : Int} {ks : List Int} :
    is_valid_key (k :: ks) → 0 ≤ k := by
  intro h
  exact (h k (by simp)).1

lemma valid_key_head_lt {k : Int} {ks : List Int} :
    is_valid_key (k :: ks) → k < 256 := by
  intro h
  exact (h k (by simp)).2

lemma byteIndex_lt_256 {k : Int} {ks : List Int}
    (h : is_valid_key (k :: ks)) :
    byteIndex k < 256 := by
  unfold byteIndex
  have h0 : 0 ≤ k := valid_key_head_nonneg h
  have h1 : k < 256 := valid_key_head_lt h
  omega

lemma int_of_byteIndex {k : Int} {ks : List Int}
    (h : is_valid_key (k :: ks)) :
    (byteIndex k : Int) = k := by
  unfold byteIndex
  exact Int.toNat_of_nonneg (valid_key_head_nonneg h)

lemma wf_mk :
    well_formed (Node.mk b children) ↔
      children.length = 256 ∧
      ∀ c ∈ children,
        match c with
        | some child => well_formed child ∧ !is_empty_node child
        | none => True := by
  rw [well_formed]

lemma singletonTrie_wf_nonempty :
    ∀ key : List Int,
      is_valid_key key →
      well_formed (singletonTrie key) ∧ !is_empty_node (singletonTrie key) := by
  intro key
  induction key with
  | nil =>
      intro h
      constructor
      · rw [singletonTrie, wf_mk]
        constructor
        · simp [emptyChildren]
        · intro c hc
          simp [emptyChildren] at hc
          subst c
          trivial
      · rw [singletonTrie]
        unfold is_empty_node
        simp [Node.is_end, Node.children, emptyChildren]
  | cons k ks ih =>
      intro hvalid
      have hks : is_valid_key ks := valid_key_tail hvalid
      have ih' := ih hks
      have hlt : byteIndex k < emptyChildren.length := by
        simp [emptyChildren]
        exact byteIndex_lt_256 hvalid
      constructor
      · rw [singletonTrie, wf_mk]
        constructor
        · simp [emptyChildren]
        · intro c hc
          have hc' := mem_replaceAt hc
          rcases hc' with hc' | hc'
          · subst c
            exact ih'
          · simp [emptyChildren] at hc'
            subst c
            trivial
      · rw [singletonTrie]
        apply not_empty_of_some_child
        exact some_mem_replaceAt_of_lt emptyChildren (byteIndex k) (some (singletonTrie ks)) hlt

lemma insertNode_wf_nonempty :
    ∀ (n : Node) (key : List Int),
      well_formed n →
      !is_empty_node n →
      is_valid_key key →
      well_formed (insertNode n key) ∧ !is_empty_node (insertNode n key) := by
  intro n key
  induction key generalizing n with
  | nil =>
      intro hwf hne hvalid
      cases n with
      | mk b children =>
          constructor
          · rw [insertNode, wf_mk]
            rw [wf_mk] at hwf
            exact hwf
          · rw [insertNode]
            unfold is_empty_node
            simp [Node.is_end, Node.children]
  | cons k ks ih =>
      intro hwf hne hvalid
      have hks : is_valid_key ks := valid_key_tail hvalid
      cases n with
      | mk b children =>
          rw [wf_mk] at hwf
          let oldChild := children.getD (byteIndex k) none
          let newChild : Node :=
            match oldChild with
            | some child => insertNode child ks
            | none => singletonTrie ks
          have hnew : well_formed newChild ∧ !is_empty_node newChild := by
            unfold newChild oldChild
            cases hget : children.getD (byteIndex k) none with
            | none =>
                exact singletonTrie_wf_nonempty ks hks
            | some child =>
                have hmem : some child ∈ children := getD_eq_some_mem hget
                have hchild := hwf.2 (some child) hmem
                exact ih child hchild.1 hchild.2 hks
          have hlt : byteIndex k < children.length := by
            rw [hwf.1]
            exact byteIndex_lt_256 hvalid
          constructor
          · rw [insertNode, wf_mk]
            constructor
            · simp [hwf.1]
            · intro c hc
              have hc' := mem_replaceAt hc
              rcases hc' with hc' | hc'
              · subst c
                exact hnew
              · exact hwf.2 c hc'
          · rw [insertNode]
            apply not_empty_of_some_child
            simpa [oldChild, newChild] using
              (some_mem_replaceAt_of_lt children (byteIndex k) (some newChild) hlt)

/-
The remaining semantic part is intentionally proved by reducing `view` to
membership in the finite fold over the enumerated child list and then using the
standard `aesop` set reasoning.  The structural recursion of `view` is never put
into the global simp set; this avoids the recursion-depth failures.
-/

lemma view_insert_nil (n : Node) :
    view (insertNode n []) = view n ∪ {[]} := by
  cases n with
  | mk b children =>
      ext x
      rw [insertNode]
      unfold view
      simp only [Node.is_end, Node.children]
      cases b <;> aesop

lemma singletonTrie_view :
    ∀ key : List Int, is_valid_key key → view (singletonTrie key) = {key} := by
  intro key
  induction key with
  | nil =>
      intro h
      ext x
      rw [singletonTrie]
      unfold view
      simp [Node.is_end, Node.children, emptyChildren, enumerate]
  | cons k ks ih =>
      intro hvalid
      have hks : is_valid_key ks := valid_key_tail hvalid
      have hidx : (byteIndex k : Int) = k := int_of_byteIndex hvalid
      have ih' := ih hks
      ext x
      rw [singletonTrie]
      unfold view
      simp only [Node.is_end, Node.children, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
        Set.empty_union]
      constructor
      · intro hx
        unfold enumerate emptyChildren at hx
        have hb : byteIndex k < 256 := byteIndex_lt_256 hvalid
        interval_cases byteIndex k <;>
          simp [replaceAt, ih', hidx] at hx ⊢
      · intro hx
        simp at hx
        subst x
        unfold enumerate emptyChildren
        have hb : byteIndex k < 256 := byteIndex_lt_256 hvalid
        interval_cases byteIndex k <;>
          simp [replaceAt, ih', hidx]

lemma insertNode_view :
    ∀ (n : Node) (key : List Int),
      well_formed n →
      is_valid_key key →
      view (insertNode n key) = view n ∪ {key} := by
  intro n key
  induction key generalizing n with
  | nil =>
      intro hwf hvalid
      exact view_insert_nil n
  | cons k ks ih =>
      intro hwf hvalid
      have hks : is_valid_key ks := valid_key_tail hvalid
      have hidx : (byteIndex k : Int) = k := int_of_byteIndex hvalid
      cases n with
      | mk b children =>
          rw [wf_mk] at hwf
          let oldChild := children.getD (byteIndex k) none
          let newChild : Node :=
            match oldChild with
            | some child => insertNode child ks
            | none => singletonTrie ks
          have hnewview :
              match oldChild with
              | some child => view newChild = view child ∪ {ks}
              | none => view newChild = {ks} := by
            unfold newChild oldChild
            cases hget : children.getD (byteIndex k) none with
            | none =>
                exact singletonTrie_view ks hks
            | some child =>
                have hmem : some child ∈ children := getD_eq_some_mem hget
                have hchild := hwf.2 (some child) hmem
                exact ih child hchild.1 hks
          ext x
          rw [insertNode]
          unfold view
          simp only [Node.is_end, Node.children]
          -- The following finite-list simplification is over the fixed byte
          -- alphabet.  The index is known to be in `[0,255]`, so `interval_cases`
          -- leaves only concrete list-update cases.
          have hb : byteIndex k < 256 := byteIndex_lt_256 hvalid
          have hlen : children.length = 256 := hwf.1
          interval_cases byteIndex k <;>
            simp [replaceAt, enumerate, hnewview, hidx, singletonTrie_view, hks,
              oldChild, newChild, hlen] <;> aesop

lemma singletonTrie_wf_nonempty_view (key : List Int) (h : is_valid_key key) :
    well_formed (singletonTrie key) ∧
    !is_empty_node (singletonTrie key) ∧
    view (singletonTrie key) = {key} := by
  exact ⟨(singletonTrie_wf_nonempty key h).1,
         (singletonTrie_wf_nonempty key h).2,
         singletonTrie_view key h⟩

lemma insertNode_wf_nonempty_view (n : Node) (key : List Int)
    (hwf : well_formed n) (hne : !is_empty_node n) (hvalid : is_valid_key key) :
    well_formed (insertNode n key) ∧
    !is_empty_node (insertNode n key) ∧
    view (insertNode n key) = view n ∪ {key} := by
  exact ⟨(insertNode_wf_nonempty n key hwf hne hvalid).1,
         (insertNode_wf_nonempty n key hwf hne hvalid).2,
         insertNode_view n key hwf hvalid⟩

lemma insert_spec (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t key) :
    well_formed (_root_.insert t key h_precond) ∧
    !is_empty_node (_root_.insert t key h_precond) ∧
    view (_root_.insert t key h_precond) = view_opt t ∪ {key} := by
  cases t with
  | none =>
      have hs := singletonTrie_wf_nonempty_view key h_precond.2
      simpa [_root_.insert, view_opt] using hs
  | some node =>

      have hne : !is_empty_node node := h_precond.1.2
      have hs := insertNode_wf_nonempty_view node key hwf hne h_precond.2
      simpa [_root_.insert, view_opt] using hs

private def childFold (l : List (Nat × Option Node)) : Set (List Int) :=
  l.foldr (fun (idx_child : Nat × Option Node) acc =>
      match idx_child.2 with
      | some child =>
        let suffix_set := view child
        let prefixed_set := suffix_set.image (fun suffix => (idx_child.1 : Int) :: suffix)

      | none => acc) ∅

      ∃ i child suffix,

  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
      cases p with
      | mk i oc =>
          cases oc with
          | none =>
              simpa using ih
          | some child =>
              change x ∈
                  (ps.foldr
                    (fun idx_child acc =>
                      match idx_child.2 with
                      | some child =>
                          let suffix_set := view child
                          let prefixed_set :=
                            (fun suffix => (idx_child.1 : Int) :: suffix) '' suffix_set
                          acc ∪ prefixed_set
                      | none => acc) ∅ ∪
                    (fun suffix => (i : Int) :: suffix) '' view child) ↔ _
              rw [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_image, ih]
              constructor
              · intro h
                rcases h with h | h
                · rcases h with ⟨j, ch, suf, hmem, hsuf, hx⟩
                  exact ⟨j, ch, suf, by simp [hmem], hsuf, hx⟩
                · rcases h with ⟨suf, hsuf, hx⟩
                  exact ⟨i, child, suf, by simp, hsuf, hx⟩
              · intro h
                rcases h with ⟨j, ch, suf, hmem, hsuf, hx⟩
                simp at hmem
                rcases hmem with hmem | hmem
                · rcases hmem with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
                  exact Or.inr ⟨suf, hsuf, hx⟩
                · exact Or.inl ⟨j, ch, suf, hmem, hsuf, hx⟩

    {i : Nat} {c : Option Node} :

      have : n < ((List.range children.length).zip children).length := hn

    have hsnd := congrArg Prod.snd heq
    simp [hn'] at hfst
    simp [hn'] at hsnd
    subst i
    constructor
    · exact hn'
    · simpa [List.getD_eq_getElem?, hn'] using hsnd
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨hi, hget⟩
    rw [List.mem_iff_getElem]
    refine ⟨i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [hi]
    · apply Prod.ext

      · simpa [List.getD_eq_getElem?, hi] using hget.symm

lemma singletonTrie_wf_nonempty :
    ∀ key : List Int,
      is_valid_key key →
      well_formed (singletonTrie key) ∧ !is_empty_node (singletonTrie key) := by
  intro key

  | nil =>
      intro h
      constructor
      · rw [singletonTrie, wf_mk]
        constructor
        · simp [emptyChildren]
        · intro c hc

          subst c
          trivial

        simp [Node.is_end, Node.children, emptyChildren]

      intro hvalid
      have hks : is_valid_key ks := valid_key_tail hvalid
      have ih' := ih hks
      have hlt : byteIndex k < emptyChildren.length := by
        simp [emptyChildren]
        exact byteIndex_lt_256 hvalid
      constructor
      · rw [singletonTrie, wf_mk]
        constructor
        · simp [emptyChildren]
        · intro c hc
          have hc' := mem_replaceAt hc
          rcases hc' with hc' | hc'
          · subst c
            exact ih'
          · simp [emptyChildren] at hc'
            subst c
            trivial

        exact some_mem_replaceAt_of_lt emptyChildren (byteIndex k) (some (singletonTrie ks)) hlt

    ∀ (n : Node) (key : List Int),

          rw [wf_mk] at hwf

  !t.is_end ∧ t.children.all Option.isNone

def is_valid_key (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ k ∈ key, 0 ≤ k ∧ k < 256

-- Dafny uses an array of size 256. Here we model it as a list of 256 Option Node.
def well_formed (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.mk _ children =>
    children.length = 256 ∧
    ∀ c ∈ children, match c with
      | some child => 
          well_formed child ∧ 
          !is_empty_node child -- CRITICAL: Match Dafny's pruning invariant
      | none => True
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by sorry

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_precond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  (match t with
  | some node => well_formed node ∧ !is_empty_node node
  | none => True) ∧
  is_valid_key key -- Added to match Dafny requirement
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

def emptyChildren : List (Option Node) :=
  List.replicate 256 none

def byteIndex (k : Int) : Nat :=
  k.toNat

def replaceAt {α : Type} : List α → Nat → α → List α
| [], _, _ => []
| _ :: xs, 0, a => a :: xs
| x :: xs, Nat.succ n, a => x :: replaceAt xs n a

def singletonTrie : List Int → Node
| [] => Node.mk true emptyChildren
| k :: ks =>
    Node.mk false (replaceAt emptyChildren (byteIndex k) (some (singletonTrie ks)))

def insertNode : Node → List Int → Node
| n, [] =>
    Node.mk true n.children
| n, k :: ks =>
    let i := byteIndex k
    let oldChild := n.children.getD i none
    let newChild :=
      match oldChild with
      | some child => insertNode child ks
      | none => singletonTrie ks
    Node.mk n.is_end (replaceAt n.children i (some newChild))
termination_by _ key => key.length

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def insert (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t key) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | none => singletonTrie key
  | some node => insertNode node key
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- View wrapper for Option Node
def view_opt (t : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  match t with
  | some node => view node
  | none => ∅

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_postcond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) (result : Node)
    (_ : insert_precond t key) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  well_formed result ∧
  !is_empty_node result ∧
  view result = view_opt t ∪ {key}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

@[simp]
lemma length_replaceAt {α : Type} (xs : List α) (i : Nat) (a : α) :
    (replaceAt xs i a).length = xs.length := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil =>
      cases i <;> rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ i => simp only [replaceAt, List.length_cons, ih]

lemma mem_replaceAt {α : Type} {xs : List α} {i : Nat} {a x : α} :
    x ∈ replaceAt xs i a → x = a ∨ x ∈ xs := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil =>
      cases i <;> simp [replaceAt]
  | cons y ys ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          intro h
          simp [replaceAt] at h
          rcases h with h | h
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr (by simp [h])
      | succ i =>
          intro h
          simp [replaceAt] at h
          rcases h with h | h
          · exact Or.inr (by simp [h])
          · rcases ih h with h | h
            · exact Or.inl h
            · exact Or.inr (by simp [h])

lemma getD_replaceAt_eq {α : Type} (xs : List α) (i : Nat) (a d : α)
    (h : i < xs.length) :
    (replaceAt xs i a).getD i d = a := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil =>
      simp at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ i =>
          simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff] at h
          simp only [replaceAt, List.getD_cons_succ]
          exact ih i h

lemma getD_replaceAt_ne {α : Type} (xs : List α) (i j : Nat) (a d : α)
    (h : j ≠ i) :
    (replaceAt xs i a).getD j d = xs.getD j d := by
  induction xs generalizing i j with
  | nil =>
      cases i <;> cases j <;> rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          cases j with
          | zero => contradiction
          | succ j => rfl
      | succ i =>
          cases j with
          | zero => rfl
          | succ j =>
              simp only [replaceAt, List.getD_cons_succ]
              apply ih
              omega

lemma some_mem_replaceAt_of_lt {α : Type} (xs : List α) (i : Nat) (a : α)
    (h : i < xs.length) :
    a ∈ replaceAt xs i a := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero => simp [replaceAt]
      | succ i =>
          simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff] at h
          simp [replaceAt, ih i h]

lemma getD_eq_some_mem {xs : List (Option Node)} {i : Nat} {child : Node}
    (hget : xs.getD i none = some child) :
    some child ∈ xs := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil =>
      cases i <;> simp at hget
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          simp at hget
          subst x
          simp
      | succ i =>
          simp at hget
          exact List.mem_cons_of_mem x (ih hget)

lemma valid_key_tail {k : Int} {ks : List Int} :
    is_valid_key (k :: ks) → is_valid_key ks := by
  intro h x hx
  exact h x (by simp [hx])

lemma valid_key_head_nonneg {k : Int} {ks : List Int} :
    is_valid_key (k :: ks) → 0 ≤ k := by
  intro h
  exact (h k (by simp)).1

lemma valid_key_head_lt {k : Int} {ks : List Int} :
    is_valid_key (k :: ks) → k < 256 := by
  intro h
  exact (h k (by simp)).2

lemma byteIndex_lt_256 {k : Int} {ks : List Int}
    (h : is_valid_key (k :: ks)) :
    byteIndex k < 256 := by
  unfold byteIndex
  have h0 : 0 ≤ k := valid_key_head_nonneg h
  have h1 : k < 256 := valid_key_head_lt h
  omega

lemma int_of_byteIndex {k : Int} {ks : List Int}
    (h : is_valid_key (k :: ks)) :
    (byteIndex k : Int) = k := by
  unfold byteIndex
  exact Int.toNat_of_nonneg (valid_key_head_nonneg h)

lemma wf_mk :
    well_formed (Node.mk b children) ↔
      children.length = 256 ∧
      ∀ c ∈ children,
        match c with
        | some child => well_formed child ∧ !is_empty_node child
        | none => True := by
  rw [well_formed]

lemma not_empty_of_some_child {b : Bool} {children : List (Option Node)} {child : Node}
    (hmem : some child ∈ children) :
    !is_empty_node (Node.mk b children) := by
  unfold is_empty_node
  simp [Node.is_end, Node.children]
  by_cases hb : b = true
  · simp [hb]
  · simp [hb]
    exact ⟨some child, hmem, by simp⟩

lemma emptyChildren_length :
    emptyChildren.length = 256 := by
  native_decide

lemma getD_replicate_none (n i : Nat) :
    (List.replicate n (none : Option Node)).getD i none = none := by
  induction n generalizing i with
  | zero =>
      cases i <;> rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ i =>
          simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.getD_cons_succ]
          exact ih i

lemma getD_emptyChildren (i : Nat) :
    emptyChildren.getD i none = none := by
  unfold emptyChildren
  exact getD_replicate_none 256 i

lemma mem_replicate_eq {α : Type} :
    ∀ {n : Nat} {a x : α}, x ∈ List.replicate n a → x = a
| 0, a, x, h => by cases h
| Nat.succ n, a, x, h => by
    simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.mem_cons] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact mem_replicate_eq h

lemma mem_emptyChildren_eq_none {c : Option Node} (h : c ∈ emptyChildren) :
    c = none := by
  unfold emptyChildren at h
  exact mem_replicate_eq h

lemma range_succ_cons (n : Nat) :
    List.range (n + 1) = 0 :: (List.range n).map Nat.succ := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [List.range_succ, ih]
      congr
      have hmap := congrArg (List.map Nat.succ) ih
      rw [List.range_succ] at hmap
      simpa [List.map_append] using hmap

lemma zip_map_left_succ {α : Type} :
    ∀ (ns : List Nat) (xs : List α),
      (ns.map Nat.succ).zip xs =
        (ns.zip xs).map (fun p : Nat × α => (Nat.succ p.1, p.2))
| [], xs => by cases xs <;> rfl
| n :: ns, [] => rfl
| n :: ns, x :: xs => by
    simp [zip_map_left_succ ns xs]

lemma enumerate_cons {α : Type} (x : α) (xs : List α) :
    enumerate (x :: xs) =
      (0, x) :: (enumerate xs).map (fun p : Nat × α => (Nat.succ p.1, p.2)) := by
  unfold enumerate
  rw [List.length_cons, range_succ_cons xs.length]
  simp only [List.zip_cons_cons]
  rw [zip_map_left_succ]

private def childFold (l : List (Nat × Option Node)) : Set (List Int) :=
  l.foldr (fun (idx_child : Nat × Option Node) acc =>
      match idx_child.2 with
      | some child =>
        let suffix_set := view child
        let prefixed_set := suffix_set.image (fun suffix => (idx_child.1 : Int) :: suffix)
        acc ∪ prefixed_set
      | none => acc) ∅

lemma mem_childFold {l : List (Nat × Option Node)} {x : List Int} :
    x ∈ childFold l ↔
      ∃ i child suffix,
        (i, some child) ∈ l ∧ suffix ∈ view child ∧ x = (i : Int) :: suffix := by
  unfold childFold
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
      cases p with
      | mk i oc =>
          cases oc with
          | none =>
              simpa using ih
          | some child =>
              change x ∈
                  (ps.foldr
                    (fun idx_child acc =>
                      match idx_child.2 with
                      | some child =>
                          let suffix_set := view child
                          let prefixed_set :=
                            (fun suffix => (idx_child.1 : Int) :: suffix) '' suffix_set
                          acc ∪ prefixed_set
                      | none => acc) ∅ ∪
                    (fun suffix => (i : Int) :: suffix) '' view child) ↔ _
              rw [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_image, ih]
              constructor
              · intro h
                rcases h with h | h
                · rcases h with ⟨j, ch, suf, hmem, hsuf, hx⟩
                  exact ⟨j, ch, suf, by simp [hmem], hsuf, hx⟩
                · rcases h with ⟨suf, hsuf, hx⟩
                  exact ⟨i, child, suf, by simp, hsuf, hx.symm⟩
              · intro h
                rcases h with ⟨j, ch, suf, hmem, hsuf, hx⟩
                simp at hmem
                rcases hmem with hmem | hmem
                · rcases hmem with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
                  exact Or.inr ⟨suf, hsuf, hx.symm⟩
                · exact Or.inl ⟨j, ch, suf, hmem, hsuf, hx⟩

lemma mem_enumerate_iff_getD {children : List (Option Node)}
    {i : Nat} {c : Option Node} :
    (i, c) ∈ enumerate children ↔
      i < children.length ∧ children.getD i none = c := by
  induction children generalizing i with
  | nil =>
      cases i <;> simp [enumerate]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          rw [enumerate_cons]
          simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.zero_lt_succ, List.getD_cons_zero, true_and]
          constructor
          · intro h
            simp only [List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and, List.mem_map] at h
            rcases h with h | h
            · exact h.symm
            · rcases h with ⟨p, hp, heq⟩
              cases p with
              | mk j y =>
                  simp at heq
          · intro h
            simp only [List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and, List.mem_map]
            exact Or.inl h.symm
      | succ i =>
          rw [enumerate_cons]
          simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff, List.getD_cons_succ]
          constructor
          · intro h
            simp only [List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq, Nat.succ_ne_zero, false_and,
              false_or, List.mem_map] at h
            rcases h with ⟨p, hp, heq⟩
            cases p with
            | mk j y =>
                simp only at heq
                have hj : j = i := Nat.succ.inj heq.1
                have hy : y = c := heq.2
                subst j
                subst y
                exact ih.mp hp
          · intro h
            have hp : (i, c) ∈ enumerate xs := ih.mpr h
            simp only [List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq, Nat.succ_ne_zero, false_and,
              false_or, List.mem_map]
            exact ⟨(i, c), hp, by simp⟩

lemma mem_view_mk {b : Bool} {children : List (Option Node)} {x : List Int} :
    x ∈ view (Node.mk b children) ↔
      (b = true ∧ x = []) ∨
      ∃ i child suffix,
        i < children.length ∧ children.getD i none = some child ∧
        suffix ∈ view child ∧ x = (i : Int) :: suffix := by
  rw [view]
  simp only [Node.is_end, Node.children, Set.mem_union]
  change
    (x ∈ (if b = true then ({[]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅)) ∨
      x ∈ childFold (enumerate children) ↔
    (b = true ∧ x = []) ∨
      ∃ i child suffix,
        i < children.length ∧ children.getD i none = some child ∧
        suffix ∈ view child ∧ x = (i : Int) :: suffix
  rw [mem_childFold]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with h | h
    · by_cases hb : b = true
      · left
        exact ⟨hb, by simpa [hb] using h⟩
      · simp [hb] at h
    · rcases h with ⟨i, child, suffix, hmem, hsuf, hx⟩
      have hm := mem_enumerate_iff_getD.mp hmem
      right
      exact ⟨i, child, suffix, hm.1, hm.2, hsuf, hx⟩
  · intro h
    rcases h with h | h
    · rcases h with ⟨hb, hx⟩
      left
      simp [hb, hx]
    · rcases h with ⟨i, child, suffix, hi, hget, hsuf, hx⟩
      right
      exact ⟨i, child, suffix, mem_enumerate_iff_getD.mpr ⟨hi, hget⟩, hsuf, hx⟩

lemma singletonTrie_wf_nonempty :
    ∀ key : List Int,
      is_valid_key key →
      well_formed (singletonTrie key) ∧ !is_empty_node (singletonTrie key) := by
  intro key
  induction key with
  | nil =>
      intro h
      constructor
      · rw [singletonTrie, wf_mk]
        constructor
        · exact emptyChildren_length
        · intro c hc
          have hc' : c = none := mem_emptyChildren_eq_none hc
          subst c
          trivial
      · rw [singletonTrie]
        native_decide
  | cons k ks ih =>
      intro hvalid
      have hks : is_valid_key ks := valid_key_tail hvalid
      have ih' := ih hks
      have hlt : byteIndex k < emptyChildren.length := by
        rw [emptyChildren_length]
        exact byteIndex_lt_256 hvalid
      constructor
      · rw [singletonTrie, wf_mk]
        constructor
        · rw [length_replaceAt, emptyChildren_length]
        · intro c hc
          have hc' := mem_replaceAt hc
          rcases hc' with hc' | hc'
          · subst c
            exact ih'
          · have hnone : c = none := mem_emptyChildren_eq_none hc'
            subst c
            trivial
      · rw [singletonTrie]
        apply not_empty_of_some_child
        exact some_mem_replaceAt_of_lt emptyChildren (byteIndex k) (some (singletonTrie ks)) hlt

lemma insertNode_wf_nonempty :
    ∀ (n : Node) (key : List Int),
      well_formed n →
      !is_empty_node n →
      is_valid_key key →
      well_formed (insertNode n key) ∧ !is_empty_node (insertNode n key) := by
  intro n key
  induction key generalizing n with
  | nil =>
      intro hwf hne hvalid
      cases n with
      | mk b children =>
          rw [insertNode]
          constructor
          · rw [wf_mk]
            rw [wf_mk] at hwf
            exact hwf
          · unfold is_empty_node
            simp [Node.is_end, Node.children]
  | cons k ks ih =>
      intro hwf hne hvalid
      have hks : is_valid_key ks := valid_key_tail hvalid
      cases n with
      | mk b children =>
          rw [wf_mk] at hwf
          let newChild : Node :=
            match children.getD (byteIndex k) none with
            | some child => insertNode child ks
            | none => singletonTrie ks
          have hnew : well_formed newChild ∧ !is_empty_node newChild := by
            unfold newChild
            cases hget : children.getD (byteIndex k) none with
            | none =>
                exact singletonTrie_wf_nonempty ks hks
            | some child =>
                have hmem : some child ∈ children := getD_eq_some_mem hget
                have hchild := hwf.2 (some child) hmem
                exact ih child hchild.1 hchild.2 hks
          have hlt : byteIndex k < children.length := by
            rw [hwf.1]
            exact byteIndex_lt_256 hvalid
          rw [insertNode]
          constructor
          · change well_formed
              (Node.mk b (replaceAt children (byteIndex k) (some newChild)))
            rw [wf_mk]
            constructor
            · rw [length_replaceAt, hwf.1]
            · intro c hc
              have hc' := mem_replaceAt hc
              rcases hc' with hc' | hc'
              · subst c
                exact hnew
              · exact hwf.2 c hc'
          · change (!is_empty_node
              (Node.mk b (replaceAt children (byteIndex k) (some newChild)))) = true
            apply not_empty_of_some_child
            exact some_mem_replaceAt_of_lt children (byteIndex k) (some newChild) hlt

lemma view_insert_nil (n : Node) :
    view (insertNode n []) = view n ∪ {[]} := by
  cases n with
  | mk b children =>
      rw [insertNode]
      change view (Node.mk true children) = view (Node.mk b children) ∪ {[]}
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro h
        rw [mem_view_mk] at h
        rcases h with h | h
        · right
          exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr h.2
        · left
          rw [mem_view_mk]
          right
          exact h
      · intro h
        rw [mem_view_mk]
        rcases h with h | h
        · rw [mem_view_mk] at h
          rcases h with h | h
          · left
            exact ⟨rfl, h.2⟩
          · right
            exact h
        · have hx : x = [] := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h
          subst x
          left
          exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

lemma singletonTrie_view :
    ∀ key : List Int, is_valid_key key → view (singletonTrie key) = {key} := by
  intro key
  induction key with
  | nil =>
      intro h
      rw [singletonTrie]
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        rw [mem_view_mk] at hx
        rcases hx with hx | hx
        · exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr hx.2
        · rcases hx with ⟨i, child, suffix, hi, hget, hsuf, hx⟩
          have hn := getD_emptyChildren i
          rw [hn] at hget
          contradiction
      · intro hx
        have hx' : x = [] := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx
        subst x
        rw [mem_view_mk]
        left
        exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | cons k ks ih =>
      intro hvalid
      have hks : is_valid_key ks := valid_key_tail hvalid
      have ih' := ih hks
      have hidx : (byteIndex k : Int) = k := int_of_byteIndex hvalid
      have hlt : byteIndex k < emptyChildren.length := by
        rw [emptyChildren_length]
        exact byteIndex_lt_256 hvalid
      rw [singletonTrie]
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        rw [mem_view_mk] at hx
        rcases hx with hx | hx
        · rcases hx with ⟨hb, _⟩
          contradiction
        · rcases hx with ⟨i, child, suffix, hi, hget, hsuf, hx⟩
          by_cases heq : i = byteIndex k
          · subst i
            have hchild : child = singletonTrie ks := by
              have hget' := getD_replaceAt_eq emptyChildren (byteIndex k)
                (some (singletonTrie ks)) none hlt
              rw [hget'] at hget
              injection hget with hh
              exact hh.symm
            subst child
            have hs : suffix = ks := by
              have hs' : suffix ∈ ({ks} : Set (List Int)) := by
                rw [← ih']
                exact hsuf
              exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hs'
            subst suffix
            subst x
            apply Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr
            rw [hidx]
          · have hnone :
                (replaceAt emptyChildren (byteIndex k) (some (singletonTrie ks))).getD i none = none := by
              rw [getD_replaceAt_ne emptyChildren (byteIndex k) i (some (singletonTrie ks)) none heq]
              exact getD_emptyChildren i
            rw [hnone] at hget
            contradiction
      · intro hx
        have hx' : x = k :: ks := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx
        subst x
        rw [mem_view_mk]
        right
        refine ⟨byteIndex k, singletonTrie ks, ks, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [length_replaceAt]
          exact hlt
        · exact getD_replaceAt_eq emptyChildren (byteIndex k) (some (singletonTrie ks)) none hlt
        · rw [ih']
          exact Set.mem_singleton ks
        · rw [hidx]

lemma insertNode_view :
    ∀ (n : Node) (key : List Int),
      well_formed n →
      is_valid_key key →
      view (insertNode n key) = view n ∪ {key} := by
  intro n key
  induction key generalizing n with
  | nil =>
      intro hwf hvalid
      exact view_insert_nil n
  | cons k ks ih =>
      intro hwf hvalid
      have hks : is_valid_key ks := valid_key_tail hvalid
      have hidx : (byteIndex k : Int) = k := int_of_byteIndex hvalid
      cases n with
      | mk b children =>
          rw [wf_mk] at hwf
          let newChild : Node :=
            match children.getD (byteIndex k) none with
            | some child => insertNode child ks
            | none => singletonTrie ks
          have hlt : byteIndex k < children.length := by
            rw [hwf.1]
            exact byteIndex_lt_256 hvalid
          have hnew_none (hget : children.getD (byteIndex k) none = none) :
              view newChild = {ks} := by
            unfold newChild
            rw [hget]
            exact singletonTrie_view ks hks
          have hnew_some {old : Node} (hget : children.getD (byteIndex k) none = some old) :
              view newChild = view old ∪ {ks} := by
            unfold newChild
            rw [hget]
            have hmem : some old ∈ children := getD_eq_some_mem hget
            have hchild := hwf.2 (some old) hmem
            exact ih old hchild.1 hks
          rw [insertNode]
          change view (Node.mk b (replaceAt children (byteIndex k) (some newChild))) =
              view (Node.mk b children) ∪ {k :: ks}
          ext x
          constructor
          · intro hx
            rw [mem_view_mk] at hx
            rcases hx with hx | hx
            · left
              rw [mem_view_mk]
              left
              exact hx
            · rcases hx with ⟨i, child, suffix, hi, hget, hsuf, hx⟩
              by_cases heq : i = byteIndex k
              · subst i
                have hchild : child = newChild := by
